summary_en: Asahipen cancelled 400,000 shares on 30 October 2026, representing 8.89% of issued shares before cancellation. Issued share count after cancellation: 4,100,000 shares.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 30 October 2026, Asahipen Corporation completed the cancellation of 400,000 treasury shares pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation was resolved by the board of directors on 7 August 2026. The cancelled shares represented 8.89% of the total issued shares prior to cancellation. Following this cancellation, the total issued share count decreased to 4,100,000 shares.
